items.title: Define red/repro test cases before full implementation
items.context: First milestone: specify the failing tests and negative controls that must be written before the full parent-roadmap/user-intent-totality gate implementation story proceeds. The tests must prove the current bug: a parent story can be DONE while child milestones remain child-story-needed, and the system can still let the final answer sound complete. Include red tests for allRowsClosed=false, partial_parent_done summary classification, child-story-needed blocking full-completion claims, and parent rollup refusing all-complete when M4-M12 rows are open. Also define the target contract after the red tests fail.

happy.desc: Plan milestone M1 lists red/repro tests before any runtime implementation story starts.

edge.desc: M1 red tests include allRowsClosed=false, child-story-needed, and partial_parent_done cases, not only a vague testing note.

adversarial.desc: Plan fails review if the first milestone can be interpreted as optional tests after implementation rather than required failing tests before implementation.

items.title: Design the gate architecture and data model
items.context: Specify parent roadmap rows, child status states, original user intent snapshot, parent rollup, claim language constraints, and DONE behavior.

happy.desc: Plan defines parent-child completion states and the ParentRoadmapLedger/ParentRollupResult data model.

edge.desc: Plan distinguishes parent governance completion from full roadmap completion using claimType and allRowsClosed.

adversarial.desc: Plan rejects full-roadmap completion claims when any child row remains child-story-needed, child-story-active, or deferred without human approval.

items.title: Write the implementation milestone plan
items.context: List the concrete milestones needed to ship the gate, including verifier, CLI integration, migration, review, rollout, and certification.

happy.desc: Plan lists implementation milestones from red tests through evaluator, CLI/DONE integration, rollout, and certification.

edge.desc: Plan includes migration and rollout behavior for legacy parent ledgers, repair, warn/enforce, and human-approved deferral.

adversarial.desc: Plan names concrete gate consumers such as story_create/story_advance/summary/DONE/convergence so the design is not prose-only.

items.title: Bind the plan to B-5082 ProofStory controls
items.context: Declare how originalIntentSnapshot, milestoneLedger, parent rollup, slice plan, and DONE intent equivalence must be used to execute this gate without scope shrinkage.

happy.desc: Plan requires originalIntentSnapshot, milestoneLedger, parent rollup, slice plan, intent collision, and DONE intent equivalence for the later implementation story.

edge.desc: Plan explains that B-5082 is story-local and must be extended with parent/child totality rather than treated as already sufficient.

adversarial.desc: Plan fails if it allows a child-story-needed row to be hidden by a narrower story-local acceptance claim.

items.title: Verify the plan document and contract markers
items.context: Run documentation marker checks and ProofStory diagnostics proving the plan names the failure, milestones, rollout, and completion boundary.
